source: #157 A-L1 host-cap recovery (RECOVERY-A-L1-MCP-HOSTCAP-R14): revision 13's entwurf_fresh_call MCP description was 2182 UTF-16 code units, over the 2048-character host description cap that the real bridge's tools/list is checked against. Provenance, in this order and not to be blended with revision 13's: main wrote the complete new literal before any producer edit; Astra independently approved it with one deletion ('Missing named session' to 'Missing session', review 948ada); main recorded the corrected complete literal (1732 UTF-16 code units); only then was this layer recorded, and only after it was the producer edited. The old value is revision 13's approved new value.

amendments.old: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside you and hand it a first task. The launch rail follows THIS agent's process context; tmux placement can be explicitly named: inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1) it requests a NEW UNFOCUSED TAB in your own herdr workspace, pi and claude-code through agent start and pi-durable through a native layout command; everywhere else it opens in the operator's tmux with all six backends (pi, claude-code, copilot, omp, codex, pi-durable). No fallback: an incomplete herdr context is refused by name, never by a tmux window you cannot see from herdr. The sibling is asked to call back before its task with the launch nonce; match that nonce and use the callback sender envelope for its garden id. This returns a LAUNCH receipt (the owner's coordinates plus that nonce): it does NOT mean the runtime started, the first turn ran, or the task was delivered. Those coordinates are a VIEW, never an address — a herdr tab/pane id can change under a running sibling. Nothing polls. For EXISTING citizens use entwurf_v2 — this tool only creates, and entwurf_peers only reports. Model is REQUIRED and passed to the chosen runtime CLI (`provider/model` for pi, an id/alias for Claude Code, `provider/model id` exactly as the catalog names it for pi-durable, a pattern for the rest). On tmux, copilot/omp/codex/pi-durable are refused BEFORE any window opens when their birth, MCP, receive or visible-identity units are absent, pi-durable also on named refusals of its installed carrier or exact SDK set, and codex also needs the operator-owned app-server socket entwurf never starts; inside herdr copilot/omp/codex are refused by name first, while pi-durable runs the same unit/carrier/SDK preflight before its layout command is requested. Optional placement.tmuxSession is a TMUX-ONLY seat naming ONE EXISTING session and ALWAYS wins; omitted, the seat follows the CALLER, never the backend opened: a CODEX CALLER opens beside its own TUI pane, every other caller in its own session; a missing one is tmux-session-missing and NOTHING is created. In herdr the field is refused by name. Do not put secrets in the task — model and task argv are visible to same-user processes.
amendments.new: Open ONE fresh visible sibling beside you and hand it a first task. Rail follows THIS agent's process context: inside herdr (HERDR_ENV=1), request a NEW UNFOCUSED TAB in your workspace: pi/claude-code via agent start, pi-durable via one native layout request; otherwise use the operator's tmux with all six backends (pi, claude-code, copilot, omp, codex, pi-durable). No fallback: incomplete herdr context rejects by name, never opens unseen tmux. The sibling is asked to call back before its task with the launch nonce; match it and take its garden id from the callback sender envelope. Returns a LAUNCH receipt (owner coordinates + nonce), NOT proof of runtime start, first turn or task delivery. Coordinates are a VIEW, never an address; herdr tab/pane ids can change. Nothing polls. EXISTING citizens: entwurf_v2; facts: entwurf_peers. Model REQUIRED, passed to runtime CLI: provider/model for pi; id/alias for Claude Code; provider/<exact catalog model id> for pi-durable; pattern for the rest. On tmux, copilot/omp/codex/pi-durable refuse BEFORE window creation if birth, MCP, receive or visible-identity units are absent; pi-durable also refuses installed-carrier/exact-SDK failures; codex needs the operator-owned app-server socket Entwurf never starts. In herdr, copilot/omp/codex reject first; pi-durable runs the same unit/carrier/SDK preflight before layout. Optional placement.tmuxSession is TMUX ONLY: ONE EXISTING session, always wins. Omitted, seat follows CALLER, not opened backend: a CODEX CALLER opens beside its TUI pane, others in their own session. Missing session: tmux-session-missing, NOTHING created. Herdr refuses placement by name. No secrets in task: model/task argv are visible to same-user processes.
